docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
Software engineering leader with over 10 years of experience building complex distributed systems in enterprise environments. Since September 2023 I have managed an organization of 20 engineers across 4 pods at AWS, delivering mission-critical customer experience features for Amazon Connect used by thousands of enterprises globally.

My expertise includes:

  • Leadership: Leading technical teams through complex projects from design to delivery
  • Architecture: Designing resilient, scalable distributed systems
  • Engineering: Building enterprise-grade solutions with modern tech stacks
  • Cloud: Extensive experience with AWS services and cloud architecture

docs.title: Ask about Dipayan
docs.text:
Ask a question and get an answer from the pages of this site. Every answer links back to the page it came from, so you can always read the full context.

Ask a question Ask

Every answer below comes from a page of this site.

What is Dipayan's current role?

Dipayan Chattopadhyay is a Software Development Manager at Amazon Web Services (AWS) in the Greater Seattle Area. He has held the role since September 2023.

Source: Home

How many years of software engineering experience does Dipayan have?

He has over 10 years of software engineering experience building complex distributed systems in enterprise environments.

Source: Home

How can I contact Dipayan?

His email is dipayan90@gmail.com. He is on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/dchattopadhyay, writes on the blog dipayan90.wordpress.com, and publishes code on github.com/dipayan90.

Source: Home

How large is the team Dipayan manages?

Since September 2023 he has managed an organization of 20 engineers across 4 pods at AWS, delivering mission-critical customer experience features for Amazon Connect.

Source: About Me

What is Dipayan's master's degree?

He holds a Master of Science in Computer Science from the University of Cincinnati, earned 2012 - 2014.

Source: About Me

Where did he do his bachelor's degree?

He earned a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science at SRM University, 2008 - 2012.

Source: About Me

What does the Amazon Connect orchestration platform handle?

The omni-channel, channel-agnostic orchestration platform he designed handles approximately 40 million contacts every month across multiple regions, supporting mission-critical business systems.

Source: Experience

What does he do for Amazon Connect?

As Software Development Manager he delivers mission-critical customer experience features for Amazon Connect, used by thousands of enterprises globally, and drove a unified state machine powering non-media workloads.

Source: Experience

What distributed systems problems did the state machine work solve?

The state machine he implemented addressed dual writes and concurrent request processing while keeping the system highly available at scale.

Source: Experience

What did he do as a Senior Software Engineer at AWS?

He led multiple teams of more than ten people that shipped contact center capabilities such as contact templates and pause-resume, developing AWS public APIs and admin and customer-facing user interfaces.

Source: Experience

What operational readiness work has he done?

He bar raised 20+ operational readiness review plans so that launches include operational best practices, reducing incidents and speeding up discovery, impact analysis, mitigation and root-causing.

Source: Experience

How does he work across teams?

He led cross-org initiatives spanning 5+ partner teams, delivering high-visibility, customer-impacting launches with minimal slippage despite aggressive timelines.

Source: Experience

How does Dipayan develop engineers?

He mentored and promoted four engineers into technical leadership roles and kept 90% team retention during high-growth phases.

Source: Experience

What engineering excellence results did he achieve?

The engineering excellence programs he instituted cut onboarding time by 50% and raised test coverage from 60% to 90%.

Source: Experience

What reliability results did his metrics-driven culture produce?

Operationalizing a metrics-driven culture reduced production incidents by 40% while achieving 99.99% system reliability.

Source: Experience

What was the ML platform at Nordstrom for?

He architected a machine learning platform that let data scientists run frequent experiments and put models into production quickly, using Apache Spark and Kubernetes for compute, training and serving.

Source: Experience

What did the data pipeline work at Nordstrom involve?

He built ingestion from HDFS, S3, Kinesis, Kafka and Redshift into an S3 data lake, with ETL written in Apache Spark plus Apache NiFi and AWS Lambda, views served through Hive and Presto, Terraform for infrastructure and Airflow for scheduling.

Source: Experience

How much data did the Nordstrom data pipeline process?

The high-throughput pipeline was designed and implemented to ingest and process 1 million records every 30 seconds.

Source: Experience

How many records did the Spark and DynamoDB pipeline move?

He configured and managed Spark clusters that processed approximately 500 million records and transferred them into DynamoDB operational datastores with fault tolerance and retry mechanisms.

Source: Experience

What did he build on the CDK Global audience management team?

He worked as a full-stack developer creating Java and Spring microservices and single-page applications with Node.js and AngularJS, plus batch and streaming big data pipelines using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Apache Spark and Akka.

Source: Experience

What was the CDK Global social media platform for?

He contributed to a consolidated social media management platform serving over 26,000 car dealerships, aggregating feeds from multiple channels through REST APIs into unified content streams.

Source: Experience

Why was he promoted at CDK Global?

He was promoted from Software Engineer I after 11 months, taking on responsibility for nine state and federal carrier integrations at nationwide scale.

Source: Experience

What did he do during the UPS internship?

As a Software Development Intern at UPS he built integration middleware with OSGI, working with JBoss Fuse ESB, Apache Camel, ActiveMQ, REST and XSLT alongside business analysts and system architects.

Source: Experience

Which open source projects has Dipayan published?

His projects are Spring Actuator CloudWatch, Deep Learning Image Similarity, Autoerroretry and Time-Series Anomaly Detection, plus contributions to the Big-data Profiler project from his time at Nordstrom.

Source: Projects

What conference talk has Dipayan given?

He presented Building an ML Platform at Scale, a talk on the challenges of building a scalable machine learning platform that supports data scientists through the whole model development lifecycle.

Source: Projects

What are Dipayan's top skills?

His top skills are Artificial Intelligence, Engineering Management and Systems Development Management.

Source: Skills & Expertise

Which programming languages does Dipayan work with?

The languages on his skills page are Java, Python, JavaScript and Scala.

Source: Skills & Expertise

Which languages does Dipayan speak?

He speaks 6 languages: Telugu and Bengali natively or bilingually, English and Hindi at full professional proficiency, and Tamil and Japanese at an elementary level.

Source: Personal

What does Dipayan do outside work?

He is an avid sports player in tennis, racquetball and ping pong, a member of the IEEE graduate student body for the Cincinnati chapter, and an active member of VIBHA Seattle, a nonprofit supporting underprivileged children.

Source: Personal

Which books have influenced Dipayan?

His reading list includes Designing Data-Intensive Applications by Martin Kleppmann, The Phoenix Project by Gene Kim, Kevin Behr and George Spafford, and Clean Code by Robert C. Martin.

Source: Personal

docs.title: Personal Interests
docs.text:
Beyond my professional work, I'm passionate about personal growth, community involvement, and staying active. Here's a glimpse into my life outside of software engineering.

🌐 Multilingual

I speak 6 different languages, at levels from native fluency to elementary, which has helped me connect with diverse teams and understand global perspectives in my professional and personal life.

🏓 Sports Enthusiast

I'm an avid sports player, regularly participating in tennis, racquetball, and ping pong competitions. I've won numerous ping-pong tournaments and believe that competitive sports build valuable skills that transfer to the workplace.

🧠 Professional Organizations

I'm a member of the IEEE graduate student body for the Cincinnati chapter, where I stay connected with the latest research and innovations in computer science and engineering.

❤️ Community Service

I'm an active member of VIBHA Seattle, a nonprofit organization focused on improving the lives of underprivileged children by providing educational resources and raising awareness about their challenges.

docs.title: Open Source Projects
docs.text:
I'm passionate about open source software and regularly contribute to projects that solve real-world problems. Here are some of the projects I've created or significantly contributed to.

Spring Actuator CloudWatch 📁 Repository

A Spring Boot library that enables application metrics to be published directly to AWS CloudWatch, allowing for seamless monitoring of Spring applications in AWS environments.

Java Spring Boot AWS CloudWatch Big-data Profiler 👤 Nordstrom (org repo)

A library for profiling large datasets in big data environments. It generates statistical metadata about datasets, making it easier to understand data distributions and quality. Contributed to this project while at Nordstrom.

Scala Apache Spark Big Data Data Analysis Deep Learning Image Similarity 📁 Repository

A tool that uses deep learning techniques to find similar images based on visual content rather than metadata. Useful for recommendation systems and content organization.

Python TensorFlow Deep Learning Computer Vision Autoerroretry 📁 Repository

A Java library that provides automatic retry functionality for failed operations, with configurable backoff strategies and failure handling.

Java Resilience Error Handling Distributed Systems Time-Series Anomaly Detection 📁 Repository

A library for detecting anomalies in time-series data using statistical methods and machine learning. Useful for monitoring systems and identifying unusual patterns.

Python Machine Learning Time Series Analytics
